Priya and Rania are sisters from Buenos Aires who love collecting signatures from authors. During their winter break from school, the sisters spend every afternoon collecting signatures. After 4 weeks, Priya and Rania compare their autograph books, counting up the number of signatures each sister has collected. Priya has 15 signatures in her book, and Rania has 36. The sisters have 2 more weeks of winter break, and they decide they want to reach 140 signatures between them by the end of the break. How many signatures do the sisters need to collect to reach their goal?

On Wednesday, he sold 14 more boxes of muffins than on Tuesday and 22 boxes of pomegranate pie. If the muffin cost ₣12 and the pomegranate pie cost ₣31, how much did Mateo earn for two days?
Diego has 3 €50 bills. He buys 3 action figures for €3 each. He also buys 8 packs of candy bars for €2 each. How much money does he have left?

The kernels increase to 6 times the initial popping rate in the next 18 seconds, but in the final 18 seconds, the popping slows down to half the rate as the past 18 seconds. After Amelia takes the pan off the heat, a quarter of the number of kernels that popped in the final 18 seconds of cooking also pop from the residual heat. How many pieces of popcorn does Amelia have to eat?
A loaf of bread at the bakery costs ₣2. Bagels cost ₣2 each. How much more do 4 loaves of bread cost than 3 bagels?

How much more money will she have if she hires the financial advisor?

Emma is required to submit a 310-page thesis. She already finished writing 3/5 of the thesis. How many pages does she have left to write?

To make a call from a phone booth, you must pay ₺0.6 for each minute of your call. After 40 minutes, that price drops to ₺0.3 per minute. How much would a 50-minute call cost?

Esteban watches TV after he finishes his homework every night. On Saturday and Sunday, he watched a 5-hour episode of his favorite show each night. On Monday, he watched a few episodes of a 15-minute show. On Tuesday, he finished homework early and watched a 6-hour episode and a 30-minute show. On Wednesday, he got to stay up late, so he watched five 2-hour episodes. If he watched 28 hours of TV in all, how many 15-minute episodes did he watch on Monday?

If he also paid $280000 for the remaining loan amount of the cottage, how much is Prof. Martinez's net proceeds from selling the cottage?

There are 101 third-graders at Sunny Hill School. 69 of them are girls. On Wednesday, 9 third-grade girls and 2 third-grade boys were absent. How many third grade boys were at Sunny Hill School on Wednesday?
